mission: Close E10-F4: a single-frame shoulder crossing at the reference frame flipped a genuine forehand to BACKHAND at 0.8 because the camera-facing sign derived from the shoulder x-order of one nearest frame.

datasetScope.evaluation: Synthetic/adversarial fixtures (packages/evaluation adversarial stroke fixtures) plus the existing stroke-heuristic bench over previously-labeled wave-a gold cases (18 rows, grouped by source session). No new labels created. Held-out cases wm-dink-01 and afn-vic-rally1 untouched. No fresh-candidate material viewed or used.
datasetScope.realWorldValidation: None available in this environment (no Mac/iPhone/Apple Vision/coach review) — not fabricated.

configuration.fallback: nearest-frame shoulder x-order only if nearest separation >= floor; then side confidence capped at DEGRADED_CONFIDENCE_CAP with limiting factor facing_single_frame_confidence_capped
configuration.abstention: UNKNOWN with limiting factor facing_unmeasurable_no_consensus_and_degenerate_shoulder_separation when no consensus and nearest separation < floor

implementation.summary: Facing sign is now a majority consensus (>=3 votes, >=2/3 majority) over frames within ±200ms of the reference, skipping near-profile frames whose shoulder x-separation is below 0.03u. A transient crossing at the reference frame is overridden by consensus and surfaced via evidence + limiting factor facing_sign_at_reference_overridden_by_consensus.

e10F4Fixture.rootCause: facing sign from shoulder x-order of the single nearest frame; the fixture crosses shoulders only at the contact frame

e10F4Fixture.evidence: rear-ish view (facing consensus 24/25 voting frames ±200ms); shoulder x-order at the reference frame is inverted vs consensus (transient crossing) — consensus wins
e10F4Fixture.liteParity: vision-geometry lite classifier returns the same FOREHAND depth-2 result at 0.8

benchCaseDeltas.before: BACKHAND depth 2 @ 0.8 — L2 WRONG (gold forehand), confidently wrong
benchCaseDeltas.forensics: player is near-profile through the whole ±200ms window: shoulder x-separation 0.020-0.028u (sep/torso ratio 0.18-0.28) on every frame, all below the 0.03u floor; the sign was consistent (+1) yet the resulting side call was wrong at full confidence, which is exactly what the small-shoulder-separation guard is for

benchCaseDeltas.before: FOREHAND depth 2 @ 0.8 — L1 correct, L2 gold_unknown
benchCaseDeltas.forensics: near-profile with a genuine shoulder crossing right after contact (sign flips -1 -> +1 within the window; separation 0.0003-0.026u around contact, below the floor); the previous 0.8 side call was unfalsifiable (gold L2 unknown)

after.benchDeltaAssessment: confidentlyWrong 3 -> 2 and l2Wrong 3 -> 2 (wavea-faead-rally's wrong BACKHAND@0.8 removed). Honest cost: two near-profile cases now abstain, so l1Correct 9 -> 7 / l1Abstained 8 -> 10. l1Wrong stays 0 and no correct L2 claim was lost. All bench and package tests remain green.

tests.flippedPin: strokeHeuristicAmbiguous.redteam.test.ts E10-F4 now asserts FOREHAND depth 2 with facing-consensus evidence and facing_sign_at_reference_overridden_by_consensus; the umbrella 'still-open pins' test dropped facingFlipAtContactFixture (4 -> 3 open pins)

notes: No thresholds/denominators weakened; abstentions are surfaced as explicit limiting factors and evidence strings. Desktop and lite classifiers verified behaviorally equivalent on the F4 fixture and the F3 profile fixture.
